authoringNotes: A questions are whole six, no per-answer allocation. A1 requires the pancreatic profile and one coherent small-intestine enzyme/substrate/product profile from three originals. Preserve the source anomaly: lactase/lactose product prints Glucose/Fructose.

A3 any two meat proteins across both lines plus any two cooking effects across both pools. A5 gluten-free symbol plus any two labelled products; full symbol original. A6 three processed-food categories. A8 three original temperature ranges.

A9 choose two textiles with matching property from all eight full profiles, plus one named flame-retardant finish. A11 two saving advantages plus two schemes, full pools. A12 original historical Tax Credit/USC details.

B1(a) four points at six cover suitability and modifications without an invented quota; retain entire six-dish menu with all ingredients/calories. B1(b) three elements at one plus three structure points at two. B1(c) each required fatty-acid class has a whole six-mark structure/example account. B1(d) three points at three and B1(e) five reasons at four.

B2(a) any three classes at three, four dietary requirements at three, three benefits at three. B2(b) two novel foods, each name two and description two, retain all seven models and accepted soya products. B2(c) one name two plus five production details at two; TVP and mycoprotein full models plus open alternative.

B3(a) definition four plus four merits at four. B3(b) flavourings ten and antioxidants ten: each two classes at one, two examples at one, two uses at one and two functions at two. Flavourings has three classes including enhancers; preserve complete multi-page table and no fixed natural/artificial-only quota. B3(c) two regulatory points at five.
B4(a) five points at four; B4(b) principle four points at three, use three at two, features two at two; complete source refrigeration process and accepted labelled diagram. B4(c) two points at four.
B5(a) four rights at four, B5(b) three causes at four and three strategies at four, B5(c) two legal-protection points at five.

C1(a) housing needs four at four; both required sectors three at three each; building standards four at four covering importance/regulation without invented split. C1(b)(ii) any three floor profiles, each whole description four and two properties at one; nine described choices across scheme18–19 plus cork/linoleum/concrete names-only. No separate name tariff.

C1(c)(i) three energy-source/sustainability accounts at five, full six source accounts plus accepted alternatives. C1(c)(ii) three emission/effect accounts at five, complete climate/acid-rain/smog guidance, no fixed category quota or invented suballocation.

C2(a)(i) original four-outfit photo and three personality points at five; technology two at five. C2(b)(i) three points at three covering classes/examples/uses in each case; no printed per-field split. C2(b)(ii) three burning-test points at two including one example, no invented separate example tariff. C2(c)(ii) method two plus two description points at two, complete lengthening/shortening source model.

C3(a)(i) two programmes: each name two, curriculum four, assessment four. Six full programmes including LCVP continuation onto scheme24, plus PLC accepted name-only. Do not manufacture details or split each whole-four criterion. C3(a)(ii)/(iii) three points at five each.
C3(b) community and volunteer benefits separately three at five each. C3(c)(i) three leisure values at five; C3(c)(ii) social five, cultural five, one additional point five.
